name: Aether Skies
source:
"Do you remember?" 
"All those made up stories at bedtime?" 
"The one about the prince and the princess?" 
"Not the ones who fell in love..." 
"But the two that walked side by side?"

The Exalt of Idwall once dedicated her life to the study of Aether, but now has more pressing matters; a mutilated king, a throne that was never meant to be hers, and a man who is the last of his kind. Her story was burned to ash and the pages are all but smeared across lies and rumors. Yet, I still remember.

Eir finds himself in the drylands of Idwall, chasing after a tiny thief who stole his mother's pendant when he literally falls upon Reina and Percival studying in the Veil de Caverns. A raided ruin by now, the site isn't known for housing aether, but that doesn't stop them from awakening what sleeps there.

Aether Skies has choice driven game-play, as well as a story that is told in the perspective of the past. It's a memoir of two main characters and not only do your choices influence one, but both in dynamic ways. The game will be released in five+ chapters with different openings for Eir and Reina. As the story progress the two characters weave in and out of each other's lives.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240229135357/https://castingdreams.itch.io/aether-skies]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你是否记得？” 
“那些睡前编的故事？” 
“关于王子和公主的那部？” 
“不是那些坠入爱河的人……” 
“但是并肩走的两个人呢？”

艾德沃尔尊者曾经毕生致力于以太的研究，但现在有更紧迫的事情；一个残缺不全的国王，一个本来不应该属于她的王位，一个是同类中最后一个的男人。她的故事被烧成了灰烬，书页上几乎充满了谎言和谣言。然而，我仍然记得。

艾尔发现自己身处伊德沃尔的旱地，正在追捕一个偷了他母亲吊坠的小偷，结果他撞到了在洞穴面纱学习的雷纳和珀西瓦尔。现在，该地点已成为一片遭到袭击的废墟，并不以蕴藏以太而闻名，但这并不能阻止他们唤醒沉睡在那里的东西。

《Aether Skies》具有选择驱动的游戏玩法，以及从过去的角度讲述的故事。这是一本关于两个主角的回忆录，你的选择不仅会影响其中一个，而且还会以动态的方式影响两者。游戏将分为五个以上的章节，艾尔和雷纳的开头各有不同。随着故事的进展，两个角色在彼此的生活中交织在一起。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240229135357/https://castingdreams.itch.io/aether-skies]Itch.io[/url]]
